name: Scenario: level run, wedged bro
description: Checks the level-run driver's stuck recovery: once driving starts on Intro level 1, player 1 is shut in a pocket three blocks wide and two high, carved into the hill at columns 26-28 and walled with blocks too tough to shoot through. Walking back out of a wall is no way out, so the recovery ladder must carry on past it to teleport within 40 s, in one stuck entry that ends recovered by teleport (or dig). The cleanup reloads the level.
